The inner pattern has 7 groups. When wrapped with `(?P<name>...)`, these become groups 1-7 in the full regex (group 0 being the full match). So:
- ymd = n + 1 = 0 + 1 = 1 → groups[1] ✓
- hms = n + 4 = 0 + 4 = 4 → groups[4]
